_note: 英語版の見せ方の設定(2026-11-27)。スポットのデータは data/ の共通のものを使う。都市の key・座標は en/i18n-en.js の EN.cities と同じ。説明文は確認できる一般的な内容だけを書く。 pins=その都市で必ず先頭に出すスポット。dayTripMinutes=日帰りの範囲を都市ごとに狭める(小さな町で東京などが混ざらないように)。

cities.name: Tokyo
cities.tagline: Shrines hidden in city forests, and old temple towns a short train ride away.

cities.name: Kyoto
cities.tagline: The old capital, with more famous shrines and temples than one trip can hold.

cities.name: Osaka
cities.tagline: Lively city shrines, and an easy base for Nara, Kyoto and Mt. Koya.

cities.name: Nara
cities.tagline: Great temples of the ancient capital, with deer in the park.

cities.name: Nikko
cities.tagline: Mountain shrines and temples among tall cedars, north of Tokyo.

cities.name: Hakone & Mt. Fuji
cities.tagline: Lakeside shrines and views of sacred Mt. Fuji, close to Tokyo.

cities.name: Ise
cities.tagline: Ise Jingu, the most sacred shrine in Shinto, and the sea at Futami.

cities.name: Hiroshima & Miyajima
cities.tagline: The island shrine of Itsukushima and its gate standing in the sea.

cities.name: Kanazawa
cities.tagline: A castle town on the Sea of Japan with quiet temple districts.

cities.name: Fukuoka
cities.tagline: The gateway to Kyushu, with Dazaifu Tenmangu nearby.
